facts.note: At the nine o'clock bell, Aurèle had everyone show their watches, and Vauthier's watch was two minutes ahead of the bell. Wording differs ('inspected' vs 'had us all show him') but the timepiece, reading and relation match.

Piquet in the salon until a quarter to eleven by Vauthier's watch, then he went to the hall for his cigar case from his coat. Madame began the piano as he went out and stopped when he came back. All elements match.
During the game, when the temple struck ten, he noticed the salon clock showed five minutes to ten and remarked on it to Madame. Matches.

added.why: Says the atelier regulator stopped at the same moment Aurèle died, linking the death to a clock stoppage. No reading is given, but it establishes a time relation the sheet does not contain.
